note: Rwanda: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa or fee for 6 months (the East African Community), 90 or 30 days; everyone else gets a visa on arrival (or an e-Visa beforehand) for 30 days. Hong Kong's 1-month exemption (from Hong Kong's Immigration Department) isn't confirmed by Rwanda's list (taken as on arrival). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration's own visa pages: they give the six months for the East African Community, the 90-day free visa on arrival for the countries they name, the fee-free 30 days for the African Union's, the Commonwealth's and La Francophonie's members (not named one by one, so those stand on Wikipedia's copy) and the 30-day visa on arrival for everyone else; Jordan, which Wikipedia's copy, read before, had among the 90-day countries, isn't named, and was moved to the visa on arrival.

sources.title: Rwanda Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration, Visa on arrival
sources.said: From 1 Jan 2018, Citizens of all countries are allowed to get visa upon arrival without prior application. Citizens of countries members to the following international organizations; African Union, Commonwealth and La Francophonie get visa upon arrival and are waived visa fees for a visit of 30 days. A citizen of East African Community Member States shall be issued a pass/entry visa free of charge upon arrival to stay for the period of six months. The following countries to be granted 90 days valid visa free of charge upon arrival: Angola, Benin, Central African Republic, Chad, Cote d’Ivoire, Democratic Republic of Congo, The Federation of Saint Christopher and Nevis, Ghana, Guinea, Indonesia, Haiti, Mauritius, Philippines, Senegal, Seychelles, Sierra Leone, Sao Tome and Principe, Singapore and the state Qatar. ... The visa fees must not exceed 50 USD for single entry visa or 70 USD for multiple entry.

sources.title: Rwanda Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration, Visitors visa (V1 Holiday purposes)
sources.said: VISA FEES * 50 USD for single entry and free of charge for nationals of countries with which Rwanda has a visa waiver arrangement including African Union, Common Wealth and La francophonie. * 70 USD for multiple entries ... VISA VALIDITY * Valid for a period of thirty (30) days for single entry or of ninety (90) days for multiple entries.
